title: node-asked
description: A request for a contract change or a breakdown written in a node's file in the working copy, signed by whoever asked; a file changed since it was opened, stopped; or why not.

conflict.description: The file changed since it was opened: nothing is asked.

opened.description: The SHA-256 of the file as it now is.

writer.description: On a conflict, who wrote the file as it now is.

revision.description: On a conflict, the revision the file now is.

theirs.description: On a conflict, the file as it now is, as base64.
